question: Why is the present effort focused primarily on own-consciousness?
premises: The primacy of own-consciousness is manifest.
Authority may be traced to the teacher, scripture, or oneself.
This effort is made with own-consciousness as primary.
inference: Because own-consciousness is manifestly primary, the exposition rightly focuses its main effort on it.
plain_english: The primacy of own-consciousness is manifest—whether from the teacher, from scripture, or from oneself; therefore this effort has been made with that as primary.
